items.title: Kyiv Biennial – A Bird That Cannot Land
items.why_candidate: Addresses geopolitics, migration, exile and post‑colonial themes through contemporary, live‑inflected biennial programming.

items.title: Holly Herndon & Mat Dryhurst – Starmirror
items.why_candidate: Interdisciplinary sound‑media installation interrogating AI, collective agency, and technological power.

items.title: Into the Chronosphere
items.why_candidate: A queering of time via performance, video, sound and design exploring archival, colonial and afrofuturist themes in line with politically urgent, experimental performance.

items.title: Abdruckkörper
items.why_candidate: The theatre debut of film director Yatri Niehaus, a post‑migrant reflection on embodied memory and belonging, fitting the identity and history thematic focus.

items.title: re‑searching joy
artists: akademie der autodidakten, led by Bishop Black
items.why_candidate: A participatory, BIPOC‑led dance and contact improvisation exploration of reclaiming joy and vitality for self‑empowerment and liberation.

items.title: Auf meinen Schultern
artists: Raphael Moussa Hillebrand, Eurico Ferreira Mathias
items.why_candidate: A memory‑laden dance performance reflecting intergenerational experience in Berlin, interweaving choreography and cello in a politically resonant form.

items.title: Arrival of the Village
items.why_candidate: An interdisciplinary performance by Magda Korsinsky investigating heteronormative family forms, care, empowerment and collective responsibility, addressing politics, identity, and decolonial care.

items.title: Afterlives by Kevin B. Lee (Desktop Documentary)
items.why_candidate: A socially engaged, experimental desktop documentary interrogating extremist propaganda, with a Berlin guest appearance.

items.title: Fragile Freiheit – Georgian Documentary Program
items.why_candidate: A politically charged, essayistic program on youth, women and family in Georgia, with post-screening discussion.

items.title: Ein Abend für Hartmut Bitomsky (Bresson & Bitomsky Shorts + Talk)
items.why_candidate: An experimental-programmatic evening combining political-historical shorts and critical conversation.

items.title: Magical History Tour – Something Different by Věra Chytilová
items.why_candidate: An experimental, international art‑cinema classic from feminist Eastern European director fitting identity and political themes.

items.title: Daumenkino – Zirkuskind by Julia Lemke & Anna Koch
items.why_candidate: A contemporary German film blending narrative and experimental moving image practices by women artists.

items.title: Sonnenbrand & Mückenstich – shorts attack Kurzfilmprogramm
items.why_candidate: A playful, yet formally varied short‑film program showcasing experimental animation and thematic shorts with post‑screening talk.
